quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Indosat, Ooredoo Group, Nokia, and NVIDIA launch Zankore by (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Indosat: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison launched Zankore by Indosat, an AI infrastructure platform built with Ooredoo Group, Nokia and NVIDIA, with a deployment target of 1 gigawatt of NVIDIA DSX AI Factory capacity; Zankore will deliver approximately 200 megawatts of AI capacity in the first half of 2027, powered by NVIDIA GB300 NVL72. Nokia's role per the release: it 'delivers AI-native networking for secure, high-performance AI infrastructure'. CEO Justin Hotard: Nokia's AI-native networking technologies 'provide the trusted connectivity fabric' for the platform.
quarterly_data.figure: 1 GW NVIDIA DSX AI Factory capacity target; approximately 200 MW in the first half of 2027 on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72; Nokia supplies AI-native networking
